_schema.description: Template for workspaces.json, the workspace registry. workspaces.json is per-machine state: it is not tracked in this repo, the tools create it on first use, and a private Hub tracks its own copy. Each entry in 'workspaces' looks like 'example_workspace'.

fields.path: workspace directory, relative to workspace_root or absolute
fields.deploy: all, work or personal: which machines deploy and monitor it
fields.type: optional, one of webapp, api, agent, skill, mcp-server, project
